The '''2012–13 Eredivisie''' was the 57th season of [[Eredivisie]], since its establishment in 1955. It began on 10 August 2012 with the first match of the season and ended on 26 May 2013, with the last matches of the European competition and relegation play-offs.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://bin617-01.website-voetbal.nl/sites/voetbal.nl/files/Speeldagenkalender%20betaald%20voetbal%201213.pdf |title=Speeldagenkalender Betaald Voetbal 2012/'13|date=5 December 2011 |access-date=25 May 2012 |work=KNVB |language=nl}}</ref> This is the first time [[Video Assistant Referee|VAR]] has been used for testing.<ref>{{Cite magazine|url=https://www.wired.co.uk/article/var-football-world-cup|title=The inside story of how FIFA's controversial VAR system was born|magazine=Wired UK}}</ref>

==Play-offs==

===European competition===
The teams placed fifth through eighth competed in a play-off tournament for one spot in the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League#Second qualifying round|second qualifying round]] of the [[2013–14 UEFA Europa League]]. Teams on the left played the first leg at home.

====Semi-finals====
The first legs were played on 16 May 2013, while the return legs were played on 19 May 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=Europa League Play-offs - Semi-finals - Netherlands|url=https://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/20122013/s7243/final-stages/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130409125238/http://int.soccerway.com/national/netherlands/eredivisie/20122013/s7243/final-stages/|url-status=dead|archive-date=9 April 2013|publisher=Soccerway|access-date=16 May 2013}}</ref>
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Groningen|Groningen]]||2–4|'''[[FC Twente|Twente]]'''||0–1|2–3}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[SC Heerenveen]]||1–3|'''[[FC Utrecht|Utrecht]]'''||0–1|1–2}}
{{end}}

====Finals====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Twente|Twente]]||2–3|'''[[FC Utrecht|Utrecht]]'''||0–2|2–1}}
{{end}}

===Relegation===
[[Roda JC Kerkrade|Roda JC]] and [[VVV-Venlo]] joined the Eerste Divisie-teams for the play-offs, after finishing 16th and 17th in the Eredivisie.

====Round 1====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Dordrecht]]||3–6|'''[[Go Ahead Eagles]]'''||3–3|0–3}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[De Graafschap]]'''||5–2|[[Fortuna Sittard]]||2–1|3–1}}
{{end}}

====Round 2====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Go Ahead Eagles]]'''||4–0|[[VVV-Venlo]]||1–0|3–0}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[MVV Maastricht]]||1–4|'''[[FC Volendam]]'''||0–1|1–3}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Helmond Sport]]||3–5|'''[[Sparta Rotterdam]]'''||2–4|1–1}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[De Graafschap]]||2–7|'''[[Roda JC Kerkrade|Roda JC]]'''||1–1|1–6}}
{{end}}

====Round 3====
{{TwoLeg start}}
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Go Ahead Eagles]]'''||3–1|[[FC Volendam]]||3–0|0–1}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[Sparta Rotterdam]]||1–2|'''[[Roda JC Kerkrade|Roda JC]]'''||0–0|1–2}}
{{end}}
